bone_local_space: Native imported Godot Skeleton3D joint basis, not Vern-local axes. Multiply skeleton transform * bone global pose * local grip/marker.
playback: Use clip seconds, lerp position and shortest-path slerp rotation between samples. During pickup/release interval use evaluated hand pose * hand_local_grip. Samples are the authoring reference; outside the held interval use rest. Keep one instance per prop. Reset to rest on cancellation.
